title: Debugging team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/debugging.yaml: the team layer of the debugging plugin's settings. Keys are read by /debugging:debug and listed in plugins/debugging/README.md, Configuration. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

always_on_signal.description: When /debugging:debug's Phase 6 record proposes one cheap, always-on signal (a log line, metric or assertion) that would have shown the deciding fact at first look. when-instrumented: only when Phase 4 instrumentation ran. always: on every run. never: not at all.
